test_title: SSC CHSL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘RETAIL’ is written as ‘FNQWJY’ and ‘POLICE’ is written as ‘NHJUTQ’. How will ‘HARBOR’ be written in that language?
solution:
Table shows the positional value of alphabets.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b86541fb46cddc7e59a5529e8ab9a76128b4f17b3cad800ad1ee02771869928.png] 

The logic followed here is:

 ‘RETAIL’ is written as ‘FNQWJY’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3889a47839cb9d1eb2d6189797e957b4e3141c9eef4871f5b4dd42f10b517bfd.png] 

And

‘POLICE’ is written as ‘NHJUTQ’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f371710ec64253d8b948991fc6f8311152c23ecef782444a1e3a09156a66082.png] 

Similarly,

‘HARBOR’ : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/013cfa4a11bcd16a8b3826cced19f60145f793331f1bb0dfdb37261e5e9b5adc.png] 

 

Hence, the correct answer is "**GTWMFW**".
